name: Tekoire Princess! ~Boku ga Mienai Kimi no Tame~
original_name: てこいれぷりんせす！～僕が見えない君のため～
source:
Big splash and scream. When Mitsuru opens his eyes, he finds himself at the bath. There is a girl in front of him sitting in surprise. "What's happened?!" He can't see his own hands... there is no body! It seems the girl can't see him either. She suddenly falls down, feeling dizzy. He folds her in his arms before she hits the ground. "Someone invisible helps me...?" As a result, he gets involved in the "Princess Selection Test"...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
伴隨著巨大的水聲和尖叫，滿睜開眼睛，發現自己身在浴室。眼前有個女孩驚訝地坐在那裡。「發生什麼事了？！」他看不見自己的雙手……身體也消失了！女孩似乎同樣看不見他。她忽然一陣暈眩，向地面倒去；他趕在她摔倒前將她接入懷中。「有個看不見的人幫了我……？」就這樣，他被捲入了「公主選拔考試」……

[摘自ErogeShop]
